input.chunk_text:
# Delivery rules
The app must let riders accept orders.
- Customers should pay by UPI or card.
- Refunds are processed within 7 days.
- Delivery fee is TBD.
| Role | Can do |
|---|---|
| Admin | manage vendors |
OTP means one-time password.
We do not want a web version. Our goal is to grow orders by 30% in a year.
input.idea_hint: A delivery app for local grocers
